record.summary: 154-page report of the advisory committee set up under the Prime Minister in November 2023 and chaired by Constantinos Daskalakis to outline a national AI strategy that exploits AI's potential while mitigating its risks, with guiding principles, six flagship programmes and recommendations in four domains. The regulatory chapter proposes a National AI Supervisory Authority to balance rights protection and innovation, supervise AI systems, advise the legislator and oversee regulatory sandboxes; harmonising national law with the EU AI Act; labour-law updates; measures protecting democracy; regulating AI to preserve information integrity; and a Chief AI Strategy Officer and a Data and AI Office.
record.notes: Published on 25 November 2024 on the Special Secretariat of Foresight's site. The chapters cover innovation and entrepreneurship, education and research, the regulatory framework and AI in the State (health, defence, civil protection, culture, justice, revenue, government efficiency, smart cities), with appendices of guidelines for working with AI and of the Chief AI Strategy Officer's mandates. The proposal for a new supervisory authority was not followed: Law 5321/2026 made the Hellenic Data Protection Authority market surveillance authority and single point of contact, made EETT the notifying authority and set up the AI regulatory sandbox at EETT, run jointly with the Data Protection Authority.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the report PDF stored from foresight.gov.gr on 12 Oct 2026 (unchanged on 17 Oct) and the study page stored again on 17 Oct 2026 (only its list of related posts changed). The PDF confirms the title, authors, mission, structure and Proposals 5.1-5.7; the study page confirms the 25 November 2024 date and that the committee was established under the Prime Minister in November 2023 and coordinated by the Special Secretariat of Foresight. The publication date appears only on the study page, which the archiver stored as the record's secondary source. The sentence on Law 5321/2026 rests on the gazette stored for GR-01 (archive/GR-01/2026-10-12/official.pdf, Articles 3-5 and 12). No Prime Ministerial decision establishing the committee was stored.

judgment.status_reasoning: A non-binding advisory report published on 25 November 2024 and still offered on the publisher's study page as of 17 October 2026; no replacement or withdrawal appears. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A report written by an advisory committee the government set up under the Prime Minister to propose a national AI strategy, with a regulatory chapter on supervision, AI Act harmonisation and information integrity: a government-commissioned report, in scope with no note.
